title.zh: 插件 ABI：跨 Rust 版本的稳定二进制边界
title.en: Extension ABI: A Stable Binary Boundary Across Rust Versions

summary.zh: ki 的插件系统使用 #[repr(C)] ABI 让宿主和插件可以用不同 Rust 版本编译。本文深入解析这个边界的设计：为什么不用 Rust trait、如何处理内存所有权、以及如何防止 panic 跨越 FFI。
summary.en: ki's extension system uses #[repr(C)] ABI to allow host and extensions to be compiled with different Rust versions. This article dives into the boundary design: why not Rust traits, how memory ownership is handled, and how panics are prevented from crossing FFI.
